PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF VAN-ZANDT, LAWRENCE IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT CHANDLER PROPERTIES AU, MANDY ALTHOUGH THE COURT DOES NOT AWARD MONEY DAMAGES, IT DIRECTS DEFENDANT TO CONTINUE TO HOLD PLAINTIFF'S PERSONAL PROPERTY UNTIL 10 DAYS AFTER JUDGMENT BECOMES FINAL. DURING THAT TIME, THE PARTIES SHALL COOPERATE SO THAT PLAINTIFF MAY RECOVER THE PROPERTY WITHOUT STORAGE CAHRGES BY DEFENDANT. AFTER THE 10 DAYS FOLLOWING FINAL JUDGMENT, DEFENDANT MAY DISPOSE OF ANY UNCLAIMED PROPERTY. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
